blind.description: A stylized modular stone wall segment featuring a small pointed Gothic arch window in the upper half. The wall is built of warm ochre/sandstone masonry with darker brown stone accent courses running horizontally above and below the window, plus a dark brick near the base. The window has a projecting stone sill and frame, with yellow diamond-latticed panes outlined in dark leaded lines. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with bevelled stone edges. It stands directly on its flat bottom edge without an added base.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular strip consisting of two warm tan stone blocks meeting at a central seam.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.1 to 1.2 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6.5 to 7 ft tall), and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
